task: author a skill package on disk

families.label: Create a skill directory with SKILL.md and its supporting files

variants.label: Full skill directory: SKILL.md plus references/, assets/, scripts/
steps: Create a directory whose name matches the skill's name field
Start SKILL.md with YAML frontmatter containing name (lowercase letters, numbers, hyphens, max 64 characters) and description (max 1,024 characters)
Write the markdown body with step-by-step procedures, examples, templates, and edge cases, keeping it under 500 lines
Put detailed documentation in references/, templates and data in assets/, and executable Python, JavaScript/Node.js, or Bash code in scripts/
Reference those files from SKILL.md so Claude knows when to load them
Declare Python or npm dependencies in the frontmatter dependencies field

variants.label: Text-only skill folder intended for admin-portal distribution
preconditions: the skill will be distributed through the admin portal, which accepts only text files
steps: Create a folder named after the skill
Add a SKILL.md file starting with YAML frontmatter carrying name and description
Write the instructions as markdown after the frontmatter
Make the folder name match the name in the frontmatter
Keep contents to text files only: .md, .txt, .json, .yaml, .yml, .csv
If Claude hands back a .skill file, keep the folder it came from instead

sources.anchor: ## Building and deploying your own skills

claude.note: only version documenting references/, assets/, scripts/ and the dependencies frontmatter field

claude-gov.note: admin-portal delivery rejects scripts and binary assets, so the folder must stay text-only

checked: government--desktop--skills ## Building and deploying your own skills (Write the skill; Mind the text-only rule; Package it as a plugin)

summary: Both products author a skill folder holding SKILL.md on disk; government restricts the folder to text files for admin-portal distribution.
open_questions: The government page links out to the generic authoring guide, so whether claude-gov authors may use references/, assets/, and scripts/ for locally created (undistributed) skills is implied but never given as steps.
No record documents on-disk skill authoring for claude-web, claude-desktop, claude-desktop-3p, claude-tag, or cowork; those absences may reflect corpus coverage rather than a real product gap.
